correctness.rationale: Writing D(t^i)=t^i F_i in B=K[t]/(t^(p^a)-1), the basis Leibniz equations are F_(2j-i)=sigma(F_i)+tau(F_j). The identities i=0,i=2j,i=j force sigma(F_j)=-F_j and tau(F_j)=2F_j. Since multiplication by two permutes Z/p^aZ, G_i=F_i-F_0 is additive and hence G_i=i v, yielding unique D=M_u+M_v delta with u,v in W. Signed doubling orbits of elements of additive order p^j have size lcm(2,ord_(p^j)(2)) and one W parameter each; LTE order lifting gives dimension formula and 1093 exception. Operator commutator yields claimed Lie bracket, with W preserved by products with delta(W). Direct independent Gaussian elimination of all 729 constraints for R9 in char3 gives nullity four, plus orbit arithmetic cases (27,25,49,121,1093^2); finite checks corroborate the general algebraic proof.
